rationale: IEC 60076-7 exponential model: per-step top-oil rise computed as steady-state value (Δθ_or × ((1+R·K²)/(1+R))^x) with exponential transition from previous rise (τ=3h). Hot-spot adds Δθ_h·K^y. Ageing rate V=2^((θ_h-98)/6). Total ageing=Σ(V_i·Δt_i)=7.0321h. Max hot-spot=104.65°C < 120°C → admissible.
